entry.label: Practice: Soft Systems Methodology: build a model that follows its purpose
entry.description: Move from a messy situation through purposeful perspectives to a logically defensible activity model and comparison. A compact SSM rehearsal. The stages organise learning here; they are not a claim that SSM is a mandatory linear project sequence. An activity model is an inquiry device, not a description of what the organisation really is.

profile.why_it_matters: A concrete rehearsal with a fictional case, explicit outputs and a way to inspect the result.
key_distinctions: Mechanical correctness is distinct from judgement in an open situation.
Training-case application is distinct from competent organisational practice.
practice_connections: Make a rich picture of the situation.
Write two relevant root definitions using PQR.
Check the resident definition with CATWOE.
Build the minimum activity model for the resident definition.
Compare the model with the case and propose one accommodation.
common_misreadings: A worked comparison is not the only acceptable answer to an open question.
